others.name: KC Small Medium Value up PEF I

what: It provides technology-based cross-border shipping, logistics and fulfillment services for online sellers and businesses in Asia and beyond.
proceeds: It expects about $16.4 million in net proceeds. It plans to use the money for its e-commerce and logistics platforms, upkeep of fulfillment centers, working capital including bills owed to suppliers, and general business needs.
risks: Rising trade barriers, inflation, conflict and other factors could cut demand for its services in Asia or worldwide and harm its business.
Higher trade tensions and tariffs will hurt its finances and results.
Pandemics, global conflicts and higher fuel costs that raise transport prices will likely hurt its business and results.
Large or unexpected rises in freight and transport costs could harm its business, finances and results.
Its business depends on e-commerce continuing to grow across Asia.
